描述_EN: pandemic was invented by matt leacock and first published in 2007. pandemic is one of the best known modern games known as euro or designer games and has been responsible for an increase in the number of co-operative games being produced. the basic idea came from a game that leacock had invented when he was a teenager. his aim was to make a game that was fun, where players each had specific roles and powers and who would have to work together to win.
描述_ZN: 大流行是由马特-莱科克发明的，于2007年首次出版。 大流行是最著名的现代游戏之一，被称为欧式游戏或设计师游戏，并对合作游戏的制作数量增加负有责任。 基本的想法来自于Leacock在青少年时期发明的一个游戏。 他的目标是做一个有趣的游戏，玩家们每个人都有特定的角色和权力，他们必须一起工作才能获胜。
